name: atari-arcade-emulator
description: Bundles the 6502.ts Atari 2600 core with the arcade's ALE-style game interface into ../emulator.js

scripts.build: esbuild ale.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=../emulator.js --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="// emulator.js: the 6502.ts Atari 2600 core (MIT, Christian Speckner and contributors) bundled with the arcade's game interface. Built from emulator/ale.js; do not edit by hand."
